newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DUTCH REST RONALD DE BOER AGAINST SAN MARINO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUTCH REST RONALD DE BOER AGAINST SAN MARINO.

text.p: The Netherlands will rest Dutch Player of the Year Ronald de Boer from Saturday's World Cup qualifier against San Marino in Amsterdam, Dutch ANP news agency said on Thursday.
The attacking Ajax Amsterdam midfielder, who is carrying a niggling knee injury, will sit out what the Dutch expect to be a formality.
However, in next Wednesday's key qualifier away in Turkey, he is set to replace Arsenal striker Dennis Bergkamp who will be allowed to miss that match because of his fear of flying.
The Dutch top group seven with three wins from three games.
